note: Copilot & AI #15. REQUIRES a paid GitHub Copilot plan on the requester account (the owner's plan is not known: confirm at Settings, Billing and plans, Copilot; Free has no cloud agent) and a second GitHub account with write access to approve the agent's pull request. The throwaway private repo is created in prepare and deleted in teardown. gate-terminal is recorded twice (before approval, then after the second account approved and the workflows ran): run the scene, do the browser steps, and run it again with -SkipPrepare; keep the second as the 'ready' take. Tokens from gh are never shown. A screen that needs a second capture of another kind lists it under 'then'.
prepare: # owner signs in to GitHub with gh (gh auth login, off camera); gh auth refresh -s delete_repo for the teardown

if (-not (gh repo view "$owner/contoso-bikes-pricing" --json name 2>$null)) { $T = "$HOME\contoso-bikes-pricing"; Copy-Item .\src\demo-repo $T -Recurse -Force; Push-Location $T; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .\review-demo, .\issues; git init -b main | Out-Null; git add -A; git -c user.name='MG Lab' -c user.email='lab@example.invalid' commit -q -m 'Contoso Bikes pricing baseline'; gh repo create contoso-bikes-pricing --private --source . --push; Pop-Location }
Push-Location src; python -m agent_ready setup-steps "$HOME\contoso-bikes-pricing\.github\workflows\copilot-setup-steps.yml"; Pop-Location

$body = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'issue01.md'; Get-Content src/demo-repo/issues/01-ready-loyalty-rounding.md | Select-Object -Skip 1 | Set-Content $body; if (-not (gh issue list --repo "$owner/contoso-bikes-pricing" --search 'Loyalty price rounds' --json number --jq '.[0].number')) { gh issue create --repo "$owner/contoso-bikes-pricing" --title 'Loyalty price rounds halves to even; finance expects away from zero' --body-file $body }; Remove-Item $body -Force

# manual (owner): on github.com run the workflow Copilot Setup Steps once by hand (workflow_dispatch) and confirm it is green; confirm the ci workflow is green on main; if the account is an organisation, enable the cloud agent policy
# manual (owner): invite the second GitHub account as collaborator with write access

screens.name: assign-issue
steps: Open the repo contoso-bikes-pricing (private), then the issue 'Loyalty price rounds halves to even; finance expects away from zero'
Right sidebar, Assignees, select Copilot; show the optional prompt field with: Run dotnet test Contoso.Bikes.sln before you finish, and the branch and model menus
Assign and show that the agent starts
mask: the account e-mail only (nothing else needs masking)

screens.name: agent-pr
steps: Wait for the draft pull request on a branch starting with copilot/ (minutes; the wait is cut in editing and said so)
Show the commits authored by Copilot with the requester as co-author and marked Verified
Show the link to the session log and the merge box with Approve and run workflows; capture BEFORE clicking it

screens.name: gate-terminal
commands: $n = gh pr list --repo "$owner/contoso-bikes-pricing" --state open --json number,headRefName --jq '[.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith("copilot/"))][0].number'
screens.note: Record twice: (a) while the pull request is a draft with no approval and workflows not run: WAIT lines, Verdict: not ready; (b) after the second account approved, the pull request was marked ready by a human and Approve and run workflows passed: all OK, Verdict: ready for a human to merge. If there is no second account record only (a) and say so.

screens.name: code-review
steps: Open the seeded pull request 'Add bulk discount total' (created by the scene prepare)
Reviewers, Copilot, Request (or python -m agent_ready review <owner>/contoso-bikes-pricing <n> --execute)
Show the real Copilot review as a Comment review with line comments, without editing or staging it
Say honestly which of the four planted problems it found: double for money, Math.Round without MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero, no validation of negative input, exception swallowed in catch
prepare: $owner = gh api user --jq .login; $patch = (Resolve-Path ./src/demo-repo/review-demo/0001-add-bulk-discount.patch).Path; Push-Location "$HOME\contoso-bikes-pricing"; if (-not (git branch --list feature/bulk-discount)) { git switch -c feature/bulk-discount; git -c user.name='MG Lab' -c user.email='lab@example.invalid' am $patch; git push -u origin feature/bulk-discount; gh pr create --fill }; Pop-Location

teardown: gh pr list --repo "$owner/contoso-bikes-pricing" --state open --json number --jq '.[].number' | ForEach-Object { gh pr close $_ --repo "$owner/contoso-bikes-pricing" --delete-branch }

# manual (owner): remove the second account's collaborator invite if the repo still exists; check Settings, Billing for the Actions minutes and AI credits used and write them in the README; cancel the Copilot plan if it was bought only for this recording; gh auth logout if the laptop is shared
needs: licence:github-copilot-paid (cloud agent: Pro, Pro+, Max, Business or Enterprise)
github-second-account (write access, approves the pull request)
blocked: The cloud agent needs a paid GitHub Copilot plan on the requester account (owner's plan unknown, owner decision); without a second GitHub account only the first half of the gate can be recorded.
